kind: Small development regression and qualitative source/reference review; NOT a quality leaderboard, factuality score, or final-test benchmark.
source_notice: The user-pasted Huang article is unverified source text. Its allegations and generated versions are not verified news and are not endorsed.

validation_scope.held_out_data: abisee/cnn_dailymail 3.0.0 validation rows 0 and 1, with their original highlights and frozen IDs/text hashes; no test split accessed.
validation_scope.additional_sources: The exact unverified user article and one 63-word synthetic closure/negation fixture without a reference.
validation_scope.reference_use: Manual comparison to existing CNN/DailyMail highlights and original source, not an invented reference or automated factuality certification.
validation_scope.metrics: Output lengths, termination, coverage and repeated-trigram occurrences are descriptive checks only. No ROUGE packages installed and no quality score claimed.

root_causes: PEGASUS checkpoint search was overridden with BART-style beam/repetition/early-stopping settings. Holding the source and checkpoint constant, restoring the checkpoint search policy recovered the main supplied claim; raising only its minimum length did not.

The OpenNMT 400-token training/benchmark policy was treated as a hard encoder capacity, forcing an unnecessary source split on the 580-token regression. Both exact checkpoints successfully read all 580 tokens directly. The app now has a bounded 1024-token work window capped by real positional limits; the fixed-budget API remains at 400.

Unnecessary final decoding shrank already-short OpenNMT intermediate outputs from 57 to 17 and 67 to 12 words. A completed source-order, exact-deduplicated merge within the preference/window no longer receives another lossy decode.

Overly small percentage-derived maximums forced short BART input to retry at 25 then 44 tokens. Native inference maximums are now minimum headroom (not minimum output length); the final short fixture completes in one call.

Minimum/length-normalization settings differed from the pinned OpenNMT recipe. The app-only profile restores it and restores cached translator/source settings in finally blocks; it does not modify the fixed-budget benchmark settings.

changes.length_policy: Preferences, not forced percentages. Bounded native summarization floors are reduced to at most one quarter of short source tokens. Native maximum headroom avoids needless cutoff/retry. EOS is still natural; no filler or sentence clipping.

preprocessing_review: All source chunks reconstruct the exact original string. Before/after use identical frozen original text hashes; changed OpenNMT chunking is explicit.
BART/PEGASUS use their checkpoint's original tokenizer and preserve source case; source totals include their tokenizer-added special tokens.
OpenNMT lowercasing/PTB normalization is the required approximation. Source has no added BOS/EOS; target vocab size matches decoder embeddings. Copying/OOV IDs and raw output tokens are saved.
Decoder-start/EOS/PAD IDs are recorded separately. BART decoder-start EOS is not treated as generated termination; HF forced EOS at a cap remains disabled in the app.

Raw outputs already contain the missing-event/relationship errors: detokenization/tag cleanup is not removing the main event. Independent official OpenNMT Translator.translate matched the custom backend on identical chunks.
Models remain cached by selection; actual checkpoints and generation configs are recorded. Request-specific source/scorer settings are restored on success and failure.
PEGASUS fixed positional-embedding warnings are unchanged; the same loaded checkpoint produced the improved direct-control output. No missing learned weights were supplied or trained.

huang_unverified.PEGASUS: 25 -> 68 words. Before omits the supplied resignation claim; after states it and the supplied two-affairs explanation. It repeats the resignation idea and does not preserve every attribution/detail; this is not verification of those allegations.
huang_unverified.BART: 53 -> 52 words. Both direct checkpoint inference and the app focus on family/company background and omit the main supplied event. Not solved by pipeline changes.
huang_unverified.LSTM: 17 -> 46 words. More background survives, but the main event is still omitted in direct and app inference. Extra words are not a successful salience fix.
huang_unverified.Transformer: 12 -> 47 words. Mentions departure/market uncertainty but does not clearly state the supplied resignation/reason; family/background still dominate. Native single-pass control has the same limitation.

cnndm_validation_0.BART: 29 -> 50 words; retains donor Zully Broussard and six transplant patients, adds source-supported detail.
cnndm_validation_0.LSTM: 24 -> 37 words; still prioritizes procedure/background and omits the main donor/six-patient event.
cnndm_validation_0.Transformer: 39 -> 34 words; final 'Zully Broussard’s gift was data processing' changes the relationship in the source. Not a faithful account of the donation's main event.
cnndm_validation_0.PEGASUS: 25 -> 48 words; still confuses donor/recipient relations ('stranger’s kidney') and repeats the transplant chain with a weak final fragment. The independent checkpoint-default control reproduces the same error; this is a backend limitation.

cnndm_validation_1.BART: 37 -> 120 words; source-order merging keeps the 20th season, growth from 10 to 20 teams and later transfer-rule discussion that the old final consolidation discarded.
cnndm_validation_1.LSTM: 39 -> 93 words; adds relevant rights-deal and rules context, but the final younger-player statement can be misattributed to Peter Vermes rather than Paulo Teixeira.
cnndm_validation_1.Transformer: 33 -> 83 words; retains history but has grammatical fragments and can conflate Vermes's and Teixeira's statements. The intermediate candidate also reversed the source's 'long gone' negation; final single-pass first-chunk output avoids that specific sentence but does not solve factuality.
cnndm_validation_1.PEGASUS: 21 -> 76 words; retains the 20th-season event and more discussion, but 'World Cup attracted 25 million viewers' overgeneralizes a source number specific to USA-Portugal and conditional economics become more certain.

synthetic_short_uncertainty.BART: 34 -> 34 words; keeps bridge closure and explicitly unconfirmed flooding cause. Completes in one pass/call after removing the too-small maximum.
synthetic_short_uncertainty.PEGASUS: 16 -> 34 words; adds attribution and explicitly preserves uncertainty about flooding.
synthetic_short_uncertainty.LSTM: 16 -> 23 words; keeps the closure/duration and detour, but omits the uncertainty clause rather than asserting its opposite.
synthetic_short_uncertainty.Transformer: 18 -> 22 words; preserves 'not approved' and 'no injuries' but misses the main closure event. No model is certified factually reliable.
